title: The frog model with death and drift on free products of complete graphs
summary: We study the frog model with death and drift on $\mathbb{D}_{m,d}$, the free product of $d+1$ copies of the complete graph of order $m$. Active and inactive particles are located at the vertices of $\mathbb{D}_{m,d}$. Each active particle performs a $α$-biased random walk towards the root of $\mathbb{D}_{m,d}$, dying after a random lifetime with a geometric distribution of parameter $1-p$.
